description: This Java class 'PressVibratorV26' extends 'PressVibratorV1' and manages vibration effects for devices running API level 26 or higher. It creates and controls vibration effects for short and long presses, utilizing the VibrationEffect API, and provides a method to trigger vibrations based on press type.

classes.name: PressVibratorV26
classes.description: A class that manages vibration effects for API 26+ devices, extending 'PressVibratorV1' and providing methods to set vibration durations and trigger vibrations.

methods.name: PressVibratorV26
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the vibrator with a given Vibrator instance.

methods.name: setDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration of the vibration and creates a one-shot vibration effect if duration > 0.

methods.name: setLongPressDuration
methods.description: Sets the duration for long press vibration and creates a corresponding vibration effect if duration > 0.

methods.name: setUseSystemVibration
methods.description: Stub method indicating system vibration setting is not supported in this implementation.

methods.name: vibrate
methods.description: Triggers the vibration effect based on whether it is a long press or not, if the effect is available and not suppressed.
